title.zh: v2.0.77 播放时步进格子不再侵入轨道头旁边那块空隙（附一个能失败的守卫）
title.en: v2.0.77 Step Cells Stop Intruding Into the Gutter Beside the Track Headers (With a Guard That Can Fail)

highlights.zh: **问题（用户报告）**：连续播放时，轨道头旁边那块空间里会出现步进格子。每行是一个 flex row，`gap: var(--trk-head-gap)`，第一个子元素是 `sticky left-0` 的轨道头——**这个 gap 在轨道头的盒子之外，没有任何东西盖住它**。刚进入时格子首列在 609px、轨道头右缘在 593px（16px 干净空隙）；一旦播放自动横滚跟随播放头，格子就从这个空隙里穿过去，看起来像轨道头和网格贴在一起。实测：**静止时空隙里 0 个格子，播放中 8 个（每轨一个）**。标尺的拍号徽章是同样的结构，同样会被穿。
highlights.en: **Reported by the user**: while it keeps playing, step cells appear in the space beside the track headers. Each row is a flex row with `gap: var(--trk-head-gap)` whose first child is a `sticky left-0` header — **the gap is outside the header's box, so nothing is painted over it**. On first entry the grid's first column is at 609 px and the header's right edge at 593 px (a clean 16 px gutter); once playback auto-scrolls to follow the playhead the cells slide straight through…

highlights.zh: **修法**：`src/index.css` 新增 `.trk-head-gap-cover`，`TrackRow` 与 `Ruler` 各在 sticky 头之后放一块。它 `sticky left: var(--trk-head-w)`（钉在轨道头右缘，也正是自然位置），宽度等于空隙，背景 `var(--panel)`——空隙本来透出的就是面板色，所以**静止状态像素级不变**。两条负 margin 是全部技巧且都必需：`margin-left` 让它落在 header 之后的空隙里，`margin-right` 抵消它自己引入的 gap，否则**全 app 的网格都会右移 16px**。实测盖板宽度 16px = 空隙宽度 16px。
highlights.en: **The fix**: a new `.trk-head-gap-cover` in `src/index.css`, added after the sticky header in both `TrackRow` and `Ruler`. It is `sticky left: var(--trk-head-w)` (pinned to the header's right edge, which is also its natural position), as wide as the gutter, with `background: var(--panel)` — which is what the gutter already showed through to, so **the resting layout is pixel-identical**. Two negative margins are the whole trick and both are needed: `margin-left` puts it in th…

highlights.zh: **守卫，以及它第一版为什么是错的。** `scripts/probe_grid_gutter.mjs`（`npm run probe:grid-gutter`，已进 `verify`）在真实 Chromium 里播放并采样每一行的空隙。两个设计要点：① **用命中测试而不是几何**——「格子是否与空隙矩形相交」在滚动时永远是 8，它们本来就该从 header 底下滚过去，问题是有没有被画出来；**第一版正是几何口径，因此放过了一个坏构建并报告通过**。② **空隙坐标在静止时采集**——报告说的「刚进入时候那个距离」就是标准，改成「播放时网格的第一列」量到的是滚动后的位置，整个检查退化成同义反复（第一版也犯了这个错）。另外 `--no-cover` 必须让它失败，否则它不算证据：实测去掉盖板后 **54/54 采样命中步进格子**，装上后三次采样全部 `gutter empty`。
highlights.en: **The guard — and why its first version was wrong.** `scripts/probe_grid_gutter.mjs` (`npm run probe:grid-gutter`, wired into `verify`) plays the pattern in real Chromium and samples each row's gutter. Two things matter: (1) **it is a hit test, not geometry** — "do cells intersect the gutter rectangle" is always 8 while scrolling, because cells are *supposed* to pass under the header; the question is whether any is visible, and **the first version used geometry, passed a bro…
